name: Shambling Mummy (ToH)

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Deathless Wrath
traits.details: The shambling mummy gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls and deals 1d6 extra damage on a hit against the last enemy to damage it and against any enemy marked by it.

traits.name: Despair
traits.details: Any enemy within the aura takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls against the shambling mummy until it damages that mummy.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.details: The shambling mummy regains 10 hit points whenever it starts its turn and has at least 1 hit point. If it takes fire damage, its regeneration does not function until the end of its next turn.

auras.name: Despair
auras.details: Any enemy within the aura takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls against the shambling mummy until it damages that mummy.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target is marked until the end of the mummy’s next turn. On a critical hit, the target also contracts mummy rot.
The target is weakened (save ends). It is also marked (save ends).
The shambling mummy pulls the target adjacent to it and immobilizes the target until the end of the mummy’s next turn.
